claim_boundary: A deterministic recorded public-ECG software replay traversed the frozen MODEL_V1 gateway, typed API, and dashboard integration path, and repeated with the same semantic outputs. NOT a real wearable E2E validation.
report_label: SOFTWARE REPLAY INTEGRATION (not real wearable E2E validation)
selection_rule: Lexicographically smallest TRAIN participant_group_id containing a run of 12 windows (within one record_id) with prediction_timestamp_us exactly 5,000,000us apart; earliest such run by timestamp within that group.
